```{=html}
<script>
// The link to the next page at the bottom reads "To the surveys" instead of the first survey's name
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  document.querySelectorAll(".nav-page-next .nav-page-text").forEach(t => { t.textContent = "To the surveys"; });
  document.querySelectorAll(".nav-page-next a").forEach(a => a.setAttribute("aria-label", "To the surveys"));
});
</script>

<script>
// The three charts are tabs: one chapter is shown at a time. The tab buttons, the numbers in the
// opening list and "See the trends" all open a chart; a link to #workers etc. opens that tab.
(() => {
  const ids = ["individuals", "workers", "firms"];
  const nav = document.querySelector(".chapter-nav");
  const links = nav.querySelectorAll("a");
  const chapters = document.querySelectorAll(".chapter");
  nav.setAttribute("role", "tablist");
  links.forEach(a => a.setAttribute("role", "tab"));
  const show = (id, scroll) => {
    chapters.forEach(c => { c.hidden = c.id !== id; });
    links.forEach(a => {
      const on = a.hash === "#" + id;
      a.classList.toggle("active", on);
      a.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(on));
    });
    if (scroll) {
      nav.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
      history.replaceState(null, "", "#" + id);
    }
  };
  // Capture phase, so the tab opens even if another script (Quarto) handles the link click first
  document.addEventListener("click", e => {
    const a = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('a[href^="#"]');
    const id = a && a.hash.slice(1);
    if (ids.includes(id)) { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); show(id, true); }
  }, true);
  // Fallback: any change of the address to #individuals / #workers / #firms opens that tab
  window.addEventListener("hashchange", () => {
    const id = location.hash.slice(1);
    if (ids.includes(id)) show(id, false);
  });
  const start = location.hash.slice(1);
  if (ids.includes(start)) {
    show(start, false);
    window.addEventListener("load", () => nav.scrollIntoView({ block: "start" }));
  } else {
    show("individuals", false);
  }
})();
</script>
```
